chains.title: TCF7L2-mediated effect on POU5F1B

links.claim: TCF7L2 occupies the variant and is expressed in HCT116. I nominate it because this is direct matching-cell occupancy evidence, not because its peak count exceeds SP1's. Alt-C-greater binding is a testable direction for this chain, not an observed result; no TCF7L2 QBiC-SELEX model or allele-specific occupancy result is supplied.
The variant lies in pELS cCRE EH38E3858447, with enhancer-associated marks reported as maxima across biosamples; HCT116-specific enhancer activity is not established.

POU5F1B is a candidate target based on proximity and the cCRE's nearby-gene annotation; gene-level colorectal-cancer evidence makes it relevant to investigate, but does not show that this element regulates it. No significant eQTL or molecular QTL for this variant is reported.
HCT116 is a plausible context because TCF7L2 occupancy at the variant and expression in this cell line are reported.

A POU5F1B expression change could be relevant to colorectal cancer, but the cited gene-level evidence does not connect this variant or TCF7L2 to the phenotype. No GWAS Catalog association for this variant is reported.

predictions: Relative to ref-T, alt-C will show greater TCF7L2 occupancy at this site; this direction is a hypothesis, not supported by the supplied allele-specific evidence.
If this chain is correct, perturbing the variant or its cCRE will produce a reproducible POU5F1B expression effect; the direction of that expression effect is not specified by the evidence.
falsified_if: A sufficiently powered allele-specific assay shows no alt-C increase in TCF7L2 occupancy, or variant/cCRE perturbation has no effect on POU5F1B expression while showing a reproducible effect on another proposed target.

HCT116 is a plausible context because SP1 occupancy at the variant and expression in this cell line are reported.

predictions: Relative to alt-C, ref-T will show greater SP1 occupancy at this site; this direction is a hypothesis, not supported by the supplied allele-specific evidence.

matrix.test: Create isogenic T-to-C and C-to-T edits in HCT116 cells and measure TCF7L2/SP1 occupancy, enhancer output, and POU5F1B and MYC expression.

outcomes.outcome: No reproducible variant-dependent TF occupancy, enhancer-output, or target-expression change.
